geographic_language_limits: One Spanish-language Colombian dossier; most other read evidence is English-language.
UK/Danish and Australian archive cases cannot represent all web archives, and institutional case studies can miss community, activist and informal preservation.
US digital-history genealogy and Black digital humanities overlap with but do not exhaust global digital history.
African, Asian, Pacific and further Latin American original-language programmes remain incompletely investigated.
The historical use of search, platforms and archives is not equivalent to a history of AI; no AI field is inferred.
identity_limits: Roy Rosenzweig is the existing shared person; Gallini’s earlier environmental-history staging identity is reused across fields.
Lara Putnam is not the already-present Hilary Putnam.
Source-discussed Ann Stoler remains a named methodological referent, not a newly invented coauthor or an unsourced whole-field influence edge.
No gender, racial, national or lifespan attributes were inferred from names, specialties, affiliations or source availability.
